intro: Authoritative answers to common stone procurement, fabrication standards, US tariffs, and container logistics questions for global developers, general contractors, and stone distributors.

items.question: What is the tariff advantage of manufacturing stone countertops in Vietnam?
items.answer: Countertops and vanity tops fabricated and exported from WHITEROCK's 20,000 m² facility in Dong Nai, Vietnam qualify for 0% Section 301 US punitive tariffs (compared to 25% on direct China imports). We provide full documentation including verified Certificates of Origin (C/O Form B/AJ/AK) for compliant customs clearance.

items.question: What are the capabilities of your Vietnam vs China Yunfu facilities?
items.answer: Our Vietnam plant is our primary high-volume fabrication export base with 20,000 m² covered workshop, 100,000+ m² annual capacity, and dedicated vanity top automated lines. Our founding base OPTIMA STONE in Yunfu, China operates 20+ years of natural stone quarry sourcing, quad-spindle CNC machining, complex 3D carving, and waterjet medallion craftsmanship.

items.question: What information is needed to obtain a fast commercial quotation?
items.answer: Please submit your architectural drawing schedule (DWG, DXF, or dimensioned PDF), target stone material (Engineered Quartz, Natural Marble, or Granite), edge profile (e.g. Eased, Bevel, 4cm Mitered), sink cutout specifications, total unit count/square footage, destination port, and delivery schedule.

items.question: What CAD drawing formats and sink cutout templates do you support?
items.answer: We accept AutoCAD DWG, DXF, Rhino 3D, and fully dimensioned PDF shop drawings. For undermount sinks, we calibrate CNC cutouts directly against DXF sink templates with 1/4" negative reveal, flush reveal, or positive reveal per your specification.

items.question: How do we order physical stone sample chips or a Master Sample Kit?
items.answer: Buyers can request individual 4x4 inch (100x100mm) physical stone sample chips or our curated 6-to-12 color Master Sample Box (WR-SM) directly via our website. Samples are prepared with standard eased edge and surface polish, and dispatched via FedEx/DHL air courier within 7-15 business days.

items.question: How do you handle color consistency and natural stone lot variation?
items.answer: For engineered quartz, our automated vacuum-vibro pressing lines maintain strict batch delta-E color consistency. For natural marble and granite, we conduct dry-lay slab photo staging and provide high-resolution slab bundle photos and range samples for buyer sign-off before precision CNC cutting begins.

items.question: What are your CNC cutting and edge-profiling dimensional tolerances?
items.answer: All cutting is performed on high-precision 5-axis infrared bridge saws and quad-spindle CNC machining centers, guaranteeing dimensional tolerances of ±0.3mm to ±0.5mm on length and width, ±1.0mm on diagonals, and 90° squareness across all panels.

items.question: Do you offer pre-assembled undermount vitreous china basins?
items.answer: Yes. We offer factory pre-glued undermount porcelain and vitreous china sinks using high-modulus structural epoxy and mechanical stainless steel anchor brackets. Every pre-assembled unit undergoes pull-load testing to ensure zero detachment during transit.

items.question: How are stone vanity tops and countertops packed for export?
items.answer: Every piece is wrapped in protective high-density EPE foam with heavy-duty corner guards. Products are loaded vertically into ISPM-15 compliant heat-treated fumigated solid plywood crates or heavy-duty steel-reinforced A-frames with moisture barrier lining. We also offer ISTA-1A drop-tested individual cartons for e-commerce and retail.

items.question: How many vanity tops or square meters fit in a 40HQ container?
items.answer: A standard 40HQ container typically accommodates 240 to 320 prefab bathroom vanity tops (approx. 14 to 18 plywood crates) or 500 to 700 m² of cut-to-size countertops, respecting maximum ocean payload limits of 21.0 to 26.5 metric tons depending on destination port road regulations.

items.question: Can we send third-party inspection agencies (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek)?
items.answer: Yes. We welcome customer-appointed inspectors and third-party inspection firms (such as SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, or Cotecna) at our Vietnam and Yunfu factories. We provide dedicated staging areas for AQL 1.0/2.5 visual inspection, dry-fit reviews, and crate seal verification prior to container dispatch.

items.question: What health, safety, and silica compliance standards do you follow?
items.answer: WHITEROCK enforces strict 100% water-suppression wet-fabrication and dust extraction across all cutting and polishing lines in compliance with international respirable crystalline silica standards. All technical documentation and California Proposition 65 disclosures are provided with every shipment.
